_comment: Two ciphertexts encrypted under ONE reused one-time-pad key (a 'two-time pad'). This is exactly what an attacker intercepts: two ciphertexts, no key, no plaintext. Task 3 recovers both plaintexts by crib-dragging. Same messages/key as the Session-A notebook (week-02-guarantees.ipynb); the key is a fixed seed (random.Random(20260806), 80 bytes) so the data is reproducible and laptop-only.
